<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 20 460 560" width="460" height="560">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrN" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="9" refX="11" refY="4.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L12,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="#000000"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="20" width="460" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- quadrilateral ABCD -->
  <polygon points="105.3,221.6 200,520 376,215.4 200,133.4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- diagonal BD -->
  <line x1="200" y1="520" x2="200" y2="133.4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- north arrow continuing the line from B through D past D -->
  <line x1="200" y1="133.4" x2="200" y2="66.4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 5" marker-end="url(#arrN)"/>

  <!-- angle DBC = 30 at B -->
  <path d="M 200 460 A 60 60 0 0 1 230 468" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- angle DCB = 85 at C -->
  <path d="M 351 258.7 A 50 50 0 0 1 330.7 194.3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- side lengths -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="17" fill="#000000">
    <text x="140" y="376" text-anchor="end">14.5 m</text>
    <text x="140" y="168" text-anchor="end">6 m</text>
    <text x="288" y="155" text-anchor="middle">9 m</text>
    <text x="224.6" y="433" text-anchor="middle">30°</text>
    <text x="304.6" y="243" text-anchor="middle">85°</text>
  </g>

  <!-- vertex labels and north label -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="19" fill="#000000">
    <text x="188" y="542" text-anchor="end">B</text>
    <text x="186" y="128" text-anchor="end">D</text>
    <text x="388" y="222" text-anchor="start">C</text>
    <text x="92" y="227" text-anchor="end">A</text>
    <text x="200" y="50" text-anchor="middle">N</text>
  </g>
</svg>
